activity_summary: You read four boxes on the plot. Gaunt is carried. The king leaves Flint a king and comes on in a London street. The Queen is in the garden. You did not take the rest of the board for a speech.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the four boxes, and did not unpeg the board.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: The hand is his. He was not beside the peg for this.

facets.activity: Read four boxes on the plot
